preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 2000.
The number of edges m must be between 0 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge indices must be valid and distinct.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimal number of merging operations required to make the graph a caterpillar.
